items.title: Mittag-Leffler condition for the sections of a constructible complex modulo the powers of an ideal on a weakly contractible affine scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a weakly contractible affine scheme, a Noetherian ring Lambda, an ideal I and a constructible complex K whose reductions modulo I^n are constant, the pro-system of H^0 over the pro-etale site with coefficients in K tensor^L Lambda/I^n satisfies Mittag-Leffler (statement lines 6204-6216). The proof (proof lines 6218-6285) lifts the compatible system of perfect complexes to the completion, compares the pro-systems of sections, and identifies the resulting pro-system with an I-adic quotient system through a collapsing spectral sequence. H2: a three-step reduction with four inputs, written out in full.
